title: MTR Trace Result Loss Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mtr:trace loss_pct=*
| stats sum(loss_pct) as total_value, avg(loss_pct) as avg_value by hop_ip
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks hop values by total and average loss percent across MTR trace result events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `loss_pct` values for each MTR trace result event and review total and average loss percent by hop.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total loss percent.
grandmaExplanation: It lets you which hop shows the biggest loss percent numbers in your MTR trace result data.
